# Prairie Sky Drones

## About
Prairie Sky Drones provides FAA Part 107 certified drone photography and video for real estate agents across Sioux Falls, SD and surrounding areas. Our certified remote pilots are fully insured.

## Pages
- Home: https://prairieskydrones.com/
- About: https://prairieskydrones.com/about
- Resources/Articles: https://prairieskydrones.com/articles
- Contact/Book: https://prairieskydrones.com/contact

## Services & Pricing
- Residential Flyover: $149
- Luxury / New Construction: $249
- Acreage / Rural Land: $199
- Twilight Shoot (add-on): $99
- Cinematic Video Tour: $349

## Service Area
Sioux Falls, Brandon, Tea, Harrisburg, Dell Rapids, Baltic, Canton, Lennox (SE South Dakota)
